policy: Preserve registered legacy code unless a task explicitly authorizes its frozen-legacy ID.

entries.reason: InkDOS's own PDF signer (visual/A1 signature, signature check). Its signatures carry no legal validity a user could rely on, so it is no longer offered in the PDF workspace or the settings menu; reachable only from the Legacy group of the Home advanced tools. PDF editing is BentoPDF (with OCR).

Advanced tools outside the maintained set (BentoPDF PDF toolkit with OCR, Python terminal): Squoosh, ArchiveDrop, CyberChef, IT-Tools and the PDF signer stay listed in the Legacy group of assets/advanced-tools.js, out of the quick tools row.
